# MathJax (bundled)

MathJax 3.2.2, from the npm package `mathjax@3.2.2`
(checked against the registry's sha512 integrity hash), so that the game works
offline. Only the parts the game uses are included:

* `tex-chtml.js`, from `es5/tex-chtml.js`;
* `output/chtml/fonts/woff-v2/`, the fonts it loads, from `es5/output/chtml/fonts/woff-v2/`.

MathJax is licensed under the Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE`.
